name: @qap/skills
description: QAP Agent Skills — generated REST-API skills plus hand-authored skills (e.g. the design system)

scripts.generate:cp: npx -y openapi-to-skills@0.3.2 ./specs/control-plane.json -o . -n qap-api -f -t templates --assets assets/qap-api --excludeTags me,workspace-layouts,teamwork,invites --excludePaths "/api/workspaces/{id}/profile" --excludeDeprecated
scripts.cp: npm run spec:cp && npm run generate:cp
